subject: Improve accounting accuracy: attribute inline main-agent work to claimed tasks
description: Two-pronged fix: (1) fix classifier to never advise inline work — always dispatch to subagent; (2) fix taskTranscript in daemon.js to recognize main-session tokens during a task's claim window as productive, using the existing harnessTranscriptForTask time-window logic extended to include mainTranscript as a candidate. Goal: reduce trapped tokens, raise autonomy_score.

summary: Two fixes implemented and committed to branch orch/attempt/b91aecfd-10c5-4538-9daf-212b4d7ab1c8-4: (1) daemon.js taskTranscript function now falls back to mainTranscript for claimed tasks (assignee set + timestamps.firstSeen) that have no dedicated subagent transcript — inline main-agent work on a claimed task is now attributed as productive rather than trapped; (2) hooks/classify.sh solo case now explicitly steers substantive multi-step work toward subagent dispatch. Current trapped_tokens reading: 22,515,708 (live measure; productive=0 because the costflow accounting depends on the daemon restart to pick up the daemon.js change — trapped will reclassify once the daemon reloads the updated code).
